title: Dive!
description: Follow submarine navigation commands with simple and aim-based movement models.
writeup:
## Approach

Process a sequence of movement commands under two different interpretations of what "up" and "down" mean.

## Part 1

`forward` increases horizontal position, `down` increases depth, `up` decreases depth. All movements are direct. The answer is horizontal position times depth.

## Part 2

`down` and `up` now adjust an **aim** value instead of depth directly. `forward X` moves forward by X and also changes depth by `aim * X`. This models the submarine pitching up/down and then moving in that direction. Same final product of position times depth.
